verdict.rationale: Rippling says it applies location-based labor policies and flags risks based on each employee's work location before payroll. It also offers custom workflows that notify people of important changes, and it handles tax filing automatically. This covers the location part of the story, plus a do-it-yourself alerting mechanism. Missing for 10: proactive alerts when a new hire or a new jurisdiction creates a filing or registration obligation, alerts on law or regulatory changes, compliance alerting beyond time-and-attendance labor rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
